    18: ## Hosted live qualification (run `38524007872`, 2026-10-14)

    25:   `2001:db8::9` alias add/remove, all with the platform's two-bare-addresses
    26:   form (the `-->` token parses as an address on this `ifconfig`, and alias
    27:   on p2p needs a destination).

    33:   pre-existing destinations keep their gateways (counter drift on ARP lines
    34:   is host noise, excluded by construction after one false-positive taught
    35:   the comparison).

    49: ## Requirement-to-evidence matrix
    50: 
    51: | Requirement (plan) | Evidence | Result |
    52: |---|---|---|

    54: | Platform-neutral OS locator + Darwin-owned address/route observation; family/gateway/flags/ifscope/identity | `DarwinAddress` (tunnel/link-local/foreign scopes + owned bit), `DarwinRoute` (destination/gateway/ifscope/owned), `DarwinObservation` (ephemeral `utunN` + lists), `DarwinDesired` — 6 pure unit tests | Passed |

    56: | Deterministic planner cases: duplicates, conflicts, renumbering, adapter changes; unsupported combinations distinguished | Unit matrix: converged→no-op, missing→add, owned-extras→remove, foreign→preserved, unowned-conflict→`Conflict`, absent/global/duplicate→refused, renumber (`utun4`→`utun7`)→re-apply without numeric deletion | Passed |

Live proof needs the backend | Partially passed (model), blocked (live) |
